claims.text: The benchmark US oil contract West Texas Intermediate rose above $100 a barrel on September 10 after Houthis seized Mocha.
Brent crude soared more than 6 percent past $107 a barrel on September 10, hitting its highest level since May.
The 30-year US Treasury bond yield reached 5.36 percent, marking a new peak since 2007.
US producer price inflation climbed to 5.4 percent in August, up from 4.8 percent in July.
A Yemeni military source told AFP that Houthi forces were advancing towards the strategic Bab al-Mandab strait.
Rystad Energy analyst Jorge Leon stated that oil flow through the Strait of Hormuz dropped from around 8 million barrels per day in late August to between 1.5 million and 2 million barrels per day.
The European Central Bank increased its benchmark interest rate to 2.5 percent on September 10.
Fighting reignited in Yemen as Houthi forces pushed south towards the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
The port city of Mokha is located approximately 80 kilometers (50 miles) from the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
Military sources and witnesses told the BBC that Houthis captured the Red Sea port city of Mokha from Saudi-backed forces.
Pro-government commander Tarek Salah stated his forces relocated their command centre on the west coast to a safe location.
A Yemeni military source told AFP that Houthi fighters captured Zuqar Island in the Red Sea following rocket barrages and a boat assault.
Houthi spokesman Yahya Sarea stated Saudi warplanes carried out 64 air strikes across four western Yemeni provinces within 24 hours.
Saudi authorities reported that Houthi missile and drone strikes on September 8 injured 73 civilians and temporarily halted operations at multiple oil facilities.
At least 25 people were killed after a fire broke out aboard a ship at a shipyard in China.
CCTV reported 25 people were killed in a fire on a foreign-flagged cargo vessel docked in Qingdao, China.
Out of 42 people on board the vessel, 17 were evacuated and five were hospitalized in stable condition.
The ship fire in Qingdao began around 11:15 local time during maintenance and was extinguished just over three hours later.
The ship involved was the Ocean Melody, a 190-meter Liberia-flagged carrier that arrived in Qingdao on August 31.
Chinese President Xi Jinping instructed authorities to thoroughly investigate fire hazards and strictly hold responsible parties to account.
A shipyard explosion in Fujian province in August killed a rescue worker and injured 12 people.
Five people remain missing following the cargo vessel fire at a shipyard in Qingdao.
RNC chair Joe Gruters opened the second night of the Republican midterm convention in Dallas, marking the one-year anniversary of Charlie Kirk's death.
House Speaker Mike Johnson warned convention delegates that swing-seat Democrats vote with socialists and that communists will be in Congress next year.
Prosecutor Joe diGenova resigned from leading a Justice Department inquiry targeting former government officials who investigated Donald Trump.
Donald Trump stated to CBS News that he does not believe Congress would need to approve proposed $5,000 checks for Americans.
Republicans gathered in Dallas to close their midterm convention ahead of the upcoming elections.
Democratic Senator John Fetterman made a surprise virtual address at the GOP midterm convention in Dallas, praising Republican Senator Dave McCormick.
Pennsylvania state Representative Malcolm Kenyatta criticized John Fetterman as the laziest Benedict Arnold America has seen and called on him to resign.
Distributing $5,000 checks to all 276.8 million American adults would cost an estimated $1.384 trillion.
The US government collected a record $195 billion in customs duties during fiscal year 2025.
The US has brought in approximately $475 billion in tariff and excise tax revenue since early 2025, with over $100 billion refunded following Supreme Court rulings.
The Copernicus Climate Change Service reported August 2026 was the joint-warmest month ever recorded globally, tying July 2023.
August 2026 was 1.65 degrees Celsius warmer than the estimated 1850-1900 pre-industrial baseline.
India recorded a mean monthly temperature of 28.01 degrees Celsius in August 2026, making it the country's warmest August since 1901.
Europe's climate monitor reported an unprecedented El Nino pattern is continuing to grow globally.
Daily global extra-polar sea surface temperature reached a record high of 21.11 degrees Celsius on August 2026.
Major European rivers including the Rhine, Danube, Southern Bug, and Dnieper experienced exceptionally low flows during August.
June through August 2026 in the contiguous US averaged 74.37 degrees Fahrenheit (23.54 degrees Celsius), breaking the 1936 Dust Bowl record by nearly 0.4 degrees Fahrenheit.
Israel announced on September 10 that it destroyed Hezbollah tunnels beneath the Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon.
The US Geological Survey recorded a magnitude 4.1 tremor in southern Lebanon near the tunnel destruction site.
Israel's military stated it destroyed a network of Hezbollah tunnels located on the Ali al-Taher ridge.
UN peacekeepers escorted NPR journalists behind Israeli lines as Israel expanded its presence in South Lebanon.
At least 24 schoolchildren died in a stampede while fleeing a fire that engulfed two schools in Bukavu, DR Congo.
Around 300 houses were destroyed by the fire in Bukavu's Kadutu commune.
M23 rebels captured the South Kivu provincial capital of Bukavu in February 2025.
South Kivu Vice Governor Dunia Masumbuko Bwenge reported 19 girls and five boys were killed, and 29 people were injured in the Bukavu fire.
A hospital in Bukavu admitted over 50 students from the fire, 14 of whom died.
Authorities confirmed at least 14 schoolchildren were killed in the fire that swept through schools in DR Congo.
